title: Import Members: "active" Variable
text:
## Import Members: "active" Variable
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000099142
In an import file for Brilliant Directories, the variable " active " decides the Active status of members. This controls whether the profile will not be visible on the front-end of the website and the search results.
Here's a quick breakdown of the " active " status values:
1 = Inactive (as in they signed up for a free account but have not verified their email address)
2 = Active
3 = Cancelled / Account Closed
4 = On Hold (usually the status an Admin would assign to temporarily suspend an account)
5 = Past Due
Remember, you can always change a member's active status later from the admin dashboard.
